plain.li: A stranger knew my name today, and said it like it was good news.
{X_nameDef} thanked me for something I'd half forgotten. I've spent the evening trying to remember that day properly.
I said it was nothing. It wasn't nothing to them, I could see that.
[trait:Kind] Somewhere out there, people say my name over supper. I keep turning that over.
[skill:Medicine] A stranger thanked me today, and I caught myself checking their color and their breathing out of habit. Healthy. Good.
[trait:Abrasive] Got thanked by a stranger and didn't know where to look. Told them to stop it. Didn't mean it.
[child] A grown-up from far away said my name like it was important. I'm going to remember it forever.
{X_nameDef} shook my hand like it was worth something.
